title: Khadijah's Steady Support
paragraphs: Khadijah bint Khuwaylid provided calm, steady support to the Prophet ﷺ during one of the most uncertain and frightening moments of his life, before he fully understood what had happened to him.
Rather than reacting with fear or doubt, she offered reassurance based on her long knowledge of his honest character, choosing calm belief over panic during a genuinely confusing situation.
Her response in that critical moment mattered enormously, since a fearful or doubtful reaction at such an early stage could have made an already difficult moment feel far more isolating.

Spouses today sometimes reflect on this story when discussing how to support a partner through uncertainty. It shows how steady belief and calm reassurance can carry someone through a frightening moment.
